senses.gloss: Veda, a brahman. § 14 (Paushyap.): I, 3, ††684 (disciple of Āyoda Dhaumya).--§ 16 (do.): V. served his master with hard work a very long time uncomplainingly. He got himself three pupils, and never told them to perform any work, that they might not experience such woe as he had himself experienced from his preceptor. He was appointed upādhyāya by the kings Janamejaya and Paushya: I, 3, ††740, ††742, ††746.--§ 17 (Uttaṅka): I, 3, ††748 (preceptor of Uttaṅka). --§ 702 (Mokshadh.): XII, 297, 10874.
